starting_size.note: At start of Match, Robot must fit within an 18" cube. After the Match begins, expansion is allowed per <SG2> and <SG3>.

motor_limit.no_other_motors: Only 11W and 5.5W V5 Smart Motors permitted. No 2-Wire motors, servos, or other actuators.

inspection_rules: <R4> Team numbers must be displayed on License Plates
<R16> Built from VEX V5 system parts
<R26> VEX Pressure Gauge required with pneumatics

endgame_activation.value: Last 20 seconds of Driver Controlled Period
endgame_activation.note: English glossary says 'last 10 seconds' but Game Design Philosophy and Chinese <SG3> both confirm 20 seconds as the authoritative value.

pins.scoring_rules: Each Placed Pin can have 1 or 2 Scored halves. Alliance-colored half → 5 pts for that Alliance. Yellow half → 10 pts (can be Owned by either Alliance via Toggle). See <SC2>, <SC3>, <SC4>.

cups.scoring_rules: Cups cover Pin halves. A transparent half of a Cup reveals the Pin color for scoring. An opaque (gray) half blocks scoring of that Pin half.

toggles.scoring_rules: A Toggle is set to a color (red/blue) when its toggle mechanism is flipped to that Alliance's color. All yellow Pins on the same side as this Alliance become Owned by that Alliance. See <SC4>, <SC5>.

criteria: Scored 7+ Pins for your Alliance (only Alliance-colored + Owned yellow halves count)
3+ Goals with 2+ scored Pins each (Goals are Alliance Goals + Neutral Goals)
No Robot touching the Field Perimeter (walls, but NOT the floor)
No violations committed during Autonomous Period

driver_period.alliance_pin_scored: 5 points per Placed Alliance-colored Pin half
driver_period.owned_yellow_pin: 10 points per Placed Owned yellow Pin half
driver_period.midfield_presence: 8 points per Robot in Midfield at end of Match

parking_rules.midfield_criteria: Robot must be contacting the Midfield (a defined raised area) to count toward Midfield points. See <SC6>.

pto_rules.restriction: Subsystem 1 motors cannot power non-Subsystem 1 mechanisms via PTO, differential, gearing, or any power-transfer method.

vertical.endgame_exception: No vertical limit during Endgame, except for robots in Midfield (18" limit)

autonomous_line.restriction: Robots must not cross the Autonomous Line during the Autonomous Period. Crossing = violation (<SG7>). Interaction with Midfield or Autonomous Line during Autonomous Period is at the Team's own risk.
